admission_apply.text: You grant the darker total. It feels agreed, then merely written, and a little steadiness goes.

native.admission_inspect: Neat ink declares the count settled. One corner is damp, and the damp does not concur.
apply_texts: The firmer number almost convinces. The damp edge darkens, and the trust does not quite hold.
The last dark digit smears under your thumb. Agreement becomes a stain, not a sum.
The last digit smears, and you prefer it still. Slight paper, heavy grant: more steadiness goes.
You decline every total. The argument loosens, and the damp disagreement is easier to hold.
You grant it again. The stroke is sure, and surer than the damp proof beneath it.
You grant the darker total. It feels agreed, then merely written, and a little steadiness goes.
You leave the totals unmatched. Modest ink, refused, returns a little calm to the hand.
You set the two figures side by side. Neither yields, and the paper stays only paper.
You sound the darker total and do not grant it. The damp corner keeps its own small counsel.
inspect_texts: A single firm number, and beside it a fainter twin waiting to be called a shadow.
Neat ink declares the count settled. One corner is damp, and the damp does not concur.
One reading left in the ink. It still offers agreement, and still only one hand made it.
The firm number looks loud for such thin paper. You do not let it finish its claim.
The hand is sure. The fiber under the ink is soft, worked past the point of proof.
The later total sits over a smaller one. Assurance arrived before any recount could.
The totals are neat and uneven. Certainty is in the hand; the damp corner withholds its vote.
The totals trade rank as you look. Whichever you grant, the wet corner has already refused.
Two totals share the line. The darker digit looks official; the paler one looks earlier.
You favor the darker figure. The pale twin reads, conveniently, as a blot from the damp.
native.name: Damp Assurance Slip
